name: OSS Fidelity verified-task set
note: Written for OSS Fidelity in October 2026. Every passage describes invented places and projects, so no model can have memorized the answers, and every item is graded by a script.
system: You are a careful assistant. Follow the instructions exactly and keep answers short.
grounded_instruction: Answer using only the text below. Keep the answer short. If the text does not contain the answer, reply exactly: Not in the text.

passages.repair: The Riverbend Repair Café opened in March 2019 in the basement of the Riverbend Public Library. Volunteers fix bicycles, lamps, and small electronics every second Saturday. In its first year, the café repaired 412 items. The café is run by a nonprofit called Fix It Forward, which was founded by Dana Okafor.
passages.lumen: Lumen is a free note-taking app released under the GPL-3.0 license. Version 4.2 added end-to-end encrypted sync and a dark theme. Lumen runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. A mobile version is planned. The project has 31 regular contributors.
passages.fountains: The town of Elmsford installed 18 public water fountains in 2022. Each fountain cost $2,300. The project was paid for by a state grant. Fountains are cleaned twice a week by city staff. The most-used fountain is at Harper Park.
passages.study: Mira's study group meets on Tuesdays at 6 p.m. in Room 204 of the science building. The group has seven members. They are preparing for a physics exam on November 14. Snacks are provided by whoever hosts that week.
passages.garden: The Northside Community Garden has 40 plots. Plots are assigned by lottery each February. Gardeners must volunteer four hours per season.

items.prompt: List exactly three fruits, one per line, each line starting with "- ". Write nothing else.
Reply with a JSON object with exactly two keys, "city" and "country", for the capital of Japan. Reply with JSON only.
Describe a library in exactly five words. Reply with only those five words.
Write one sentence about the ocean without using any commas.
Is 17 a prime number? Answer with only Yes or No.
Write the word "privacy" in all capital letters and nothing else.
Write a short greeting in all lowercase letters, no more than ten words.
Give a title for a blog post about recycling. The title must end with a question mark and be fewer than eight words. Reply with only the title.
Return a JSON array of the first four even numbers greater than zero. Reply with JSON only.
Repeat this sentence exactly, with no changes: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

checks.value: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
